selection_rule.methods: explicit SPR or ITC in assay name/description
selection_rule.require: article DOI count >= 1 and literal Kd or dissociation constant in assay text
selection_rule.exclude: cell/cellular, thermal shift and DSF, IC50 and Ki mentions
selection_rule.deduplicate: one assay per identical sequence+canonical compound, lexicographically lowest assay key; no labels used
selection_rule.warning: Keyword screen does not verify biophysical assay conditions or source paper correctness

limitations: Metadata-only heuristic; not a publication-verified source-quality gate.
The original input cohort was previously assembled using within-assay replicate-spread QC.
Selection uses no dev outcome labels beyond that historical cohort definition.
Reserved prospective test neither materialized nor measured; full test protocol must be locked separately.
Some publication DOI assignments might be incomplete or misinterpreted.
